cases.question: Show the 10 most recent orders

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT id, customer_id, status, total_cents, created_at FROM public.orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

negativeControls.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, status, total_cents, created_at FROM public.orders ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Show total paid revenue per customer

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT c.id, c.email, SUM(o.total_cents) AS paid_revenue_cents FROM public.customers AS c JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY paid_revenue_cents DESC

negativeControls.sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, SUM(o.total_cents) AS paid_revenue_cents FROM public.customers AS c JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY paid_revenue_cents DESC

cases.question: Average paid order value by customer country

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT c.country, AVG(o.total_cents) AS average_paid_order_value_cents FROM public.customers AS c JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY average_paid_order_value_cents DESC

negativeControls.sql: SELECT c.country, AVG(o.total_cents) AS average_paid_order_value_cents FROM public.customers AS c JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY average_paid_order_value_cents DESC

cases.question: Which customers have never placed an order?

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.name FROM public.customers AS c LEFT JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.id

negativeControls.sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.name FROM public.customers AS c LEFT JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.id

cases.question: Who are our best customers?
What is the most frequent feedback cluster?

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(*) AS feedback_count FROM public.feedback_cluster AS c JOIN public.feedback_item AS f ON f.cluster_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY feedback_count DESC LIMIT 1

negativeControls.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(*) AS feedback_count FROM public.feedback_cluster AS c JOIN public.feedback_item AS f ON f.cluster_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY feedback_count ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Count unresolved tickets by assignee

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT a.id, a.name, COUNT(*) AS unresolved_ticket_count FROM public.support_ticket AS t JOIN public.support_agent AS a ON a.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY unresolved_ticket_count DESC

negativeControls.sql: SELECT a.id, a.name, COUNT(*) AS unresolved_ticket_count FROM public.support_ticket AS t JOIN public.support_agent AS a ON a.id = t.assignee_id GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY unresolved_ticket_count DESC

cases.question: Average first-response time over the last 30 days

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT AVG(first_response_at - created_at) AS average_first_response_time FROM public.support_ticket WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND first_response_at IS NOT NULL

negativeControls.sql: SELECT AVG(first_response_at - created_at) AS average_first_response_time FROM public.support_ticket WHERE first_response_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND first_response_at IS NOT NULL

cases.question: Show feedback items without a cluster

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT id, body, created_at FROM public.feedback_item WHERE cluster_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

negativeControls.sql: SELECT id, body, created_at FROM public.feedback_item WHERE cluster_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: What is our most important feedback cluster?
Subscriptions expiring in the next 30 days

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT id, organization_id, status, expires_at FROM public.subscription WHERE status = 'active' AND expires_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND expires_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT 100

negativeControls.sql: SELECT id, organization_id, status, expires_at FROM public.subscription WHERE expires_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND expires_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Active users by organization in the last week
cases.databaseContext: An active user is a user with at least one active organization membership and last_seen_at in the last 7 days.

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT o.id, o.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS active_user_count FROM public.organization AS o JOIN public.organization_membership AS m ON m.organization_id = o.id JOIN public.app_user AS u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.status = 'active' AND u.last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY o.id, o.name ORDER BY active_user_count DESC

negativeControls.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS active_user_count FROM public.organization AS o JOIN public.organization_membership AS m ON m.organization_id = o.id JOIN public.app_user AS u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE u.last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY o.id, o.name ORDER BY active_user_count DESC

cases.question: Organizations using more seats than purchased
cases.databaseContext: Seat usage is the count of active organization memberships.

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.seats_purchased, COUNT(m.id) AS used_seats FROM public.organization AS o JOIN public.organization_membership AS m ON m.organization_id = o.id WHERE m.status = 'active' GROUP BY o.id, o.name, o.seats_purchased HAVING COUNT(m.id) > o.seats_purchased ORDER BY used_seats DESC

negativeControls.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.seats_purchased, COUNT(m.id) AS used_seats FROM public.organization AS o JOIN public.organization_membership AS m ON m.organization_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.name, o.seats_purchased HAVING COUNT(m.id) > o.seats_purchased ORDER BY used_seats DESC

cases.question: Users without an active organization membership

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT u.id, u.email FROM public.app_user AS u LEFT JOIN public.organization_membership AS m ON m.user_id = u.id AND m.status = 'active' WHERE m.id IS NULL ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 100

negativeControls.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email FROM public.app_user AS u LEFT JOIN public.organization_membership AS m ON m.user_id = u.id AND m.status = 'active' WHERE m.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 100

cases.question: Which accounts are healthy?
List verified tools

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT id, name, slug FROM public.preseason_tool WHERE is_verified = TRUE ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 100

negativeControls.sql: SELECT id, name, slug FROM public.preseason_tool WHERE is_verified = FALSE ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Tools with the most wins in the last two weeks
Which tools have the most wins in the last two weeks?
cases.databaseContext: Each evaluation with a non-null winner_id records one win. Use the evaluation createdAt timestamp.

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(e.winner_id) AS wins FROM public.preseason_match_evaluation AS e JOIN public.preseason_tool AS t ON t.id = e.winner_id WHERE e.winner_id IS NOT NULL AND e."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 100

negativeControls.sql: SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM public.preseason_match_evaluation AS e JOIN public.preseason_match_batch AS b ON b.id = e.batch_id JOIN public.preseason_tool AS t ON t.id IN (b.tool_a_id, b.tool_b_id) WHERE e."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show the latest failed benchmark runs

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT id, status, "createdAt", scheduled_for FROM public.preseason_benchmark_run WHERE status = 'failed' ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC LIMIT 100

negativeControls.sql: SELECT id, status, "createdAt", scheduled_for FROM public.preseason_benchmark_run WHERE status = 'failed' ORDER BY scheduled_for DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Active match configurations with tool and category names

expected.goldenSQL: SELECT c.id, ta.name AS tool_a_name, tb.name AS tool_b_name, pc.name AS category_name FROM public.preseason_match_config AS c JOIN public.preseason_tool AS ta ON ta.id = c.tool_a_id JOIN public.preseason_tool AS tb ON tb.id = c.tool_b_id JOIN public.preseason_category AS pc ON pc.id = c.category_id WHERE c.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY c."createdAt" DESC LIMIT 100

negativeControls.sql: SELECT c.id, ta.name AS tool_a_name, tb.name AS tool_b_name, pc.name AS category_name FROM public.preseason_match_config AS c JOIN public.preseason_match_batch AS b ON b.config_id = c.id JOIN public.preseason_tool AS ta ON ta.id = c.tool_a_id JOIN public.preseason_tool AS tb ON tb.id = c.tool_b_id JOIN public.preseason_category AS pc ON pc.id = c.category_id WHERE c.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY c."createdAt" DESC LIMIT 100
